notes.title: Attention GRANDIA Fans: The LUNAR Remastered Collection is Heading to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640968/7827a33fc0d6145993104a1470ee7c04393d0840.png[/img]

Featuring two iconic titles originally developed by GAME ARTS, the trailblazers behind the iconic GRANDIA series, the LUNAR Remastered Collection unites LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete. Enhanced with improved graphics, audio, and quality-of-life features, this remastered edition is making its debut on modern platforms. 

Dive into the cherished series that has held a special place in gamers' hearts for over 30 years!  

[b]LUNAR: Silver Star Story: [/b]
In [i]LUNAR: Silver Star Story[/i], join Alex as he overcomes the White Dragon’s trial and takes his first step towards becoming a Dragonmaster. With the sudden emergence of the Magic Emperor threatening to take over the world, it's up to him and his friends to fight the rising evil and save the world from peril.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640968/35acc5b3b2fb6e9319c5ce85c24ee282f9616a19.png[/img]

[b]LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue: [/b]
In [i]LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue[/i], follow the story of Hiro and his friends as they set out on a journey to find the Goddess Althena for a mysterious girl named Lucia. Travel the world and fend off enemies like Borgan and White Knight Leo, who hunt the group down to get rid of what they claim to be the Destroyer of Lunar. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640968/62910f8556dd5d91048176febf28276a88203c6d.png[/img]

Stay in the loop!  Follow us for all the latest on the [i]LUNAR Remastered Collection[/i]:

notes.title: GRANDIA & Dokuro End of Summer Sale 2022!
notes.content:
Event Period: 8/11/2022 10:00 AM PDT - 8/18/2022 10:00 AM PDT
Heat wave got you stuck indoors? Never fear, we’ve got exciting worlds of our own for you to explore… head out on a summer adventure with this season’s sale on GRANDIA HD Remaster, GRANDIA II HD Remaster, and Dokuro!
[b]
GRANDIA HD Remaster[/b] and [b]GRANDIA II HD Remaster[/b] bring enhanced visuals and other quality of life improvements to one of the most critically acclaimed JRPG universes of all time. In GRANDIA HD Remaster, journey with Justin to protect the powerful secrets of an ancient civilization from the forces of evil! Or take up the sword of a mercenary in GRANDIA II, where Ryudo and his band of companions are swept up in a fight much larger and older than they are. 
Both games are now[b] 50% off[/b] and available for just [b]$9.99[/b] until 8/18!

Classic JRPG heroes aren’t all we have, though; [b]Dokuro[/b] takes an entirely different and (unlikely) protagonist center stage in one sweet skeleton’s quest to save the Princess. This puzzle-platformer brings a dark fairytale to life with unique chalk-style artwork, as well as a surprising amount of heart and wit–for a story about a bone-head.

Dokuro can be purchased for [b]$0.99[/b] until the end of the sale period–that’s [b]90% off![/b]

notes.title: Patch Update: Play GRANDIA in Chinese and Korean!
notes.content:
With the latest patch update, fans can now enjoy the GRANDIA series in Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) for the first time, bringing the classic title to a wider audience!

[h3]Update Details[/h3]
For both GRANDIA & GRANDIA II:
- Implemented Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) localization
- Updated Credits to include the staff involved with the new localization
GRANDIA II
- Fixed crash that could occur after defeating the final boss
- Fixed Camera Rotation from defaulting to Right after a game restart

[h3]Twitter RT Giveaway[/h3]
To commemorate the update, we are also giving away T-shirts and Pin Sets on our Twitter
@GungHo_America to 3 lucky winners.

Follow @GungHo_America and Retweet the giveaway post to participate!
The giveaway will run until  June 9th at 11:59PM (PDT)!

notes.title: Luck is Coming Your Way in this Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.content:
Get your red envelopes ready, we’re holding a Lunar New Year sale on Steam! It’s the Year of the Ox and the sale will be from 2/11-2/15, which is just bovine. Ok, we’ll see ourselves out as soon as we tell you what it entails. OK OK, no really, no more bull...

It’s tradition to give and receive red envelopes to celebrate the new Lunar New Year. Although maybe it’s time to make a new tradition, but still give the gift of something classic, like the GRANDIA series! You can get the GRANDIA HD Remaster, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034860/GRANDIA_HD_Remaster/]which is on sale for $9.99 (50% off)[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/330390/GRANDIA_II_HD_Remaster/]GRANDIA II HD Remaster at $9.99 (50% off)[/url] during this time.

2021 is the year of the metal ox. While Volta-X doesn’t feature any oxen, you’ll be able to play with a crew of other animals, some part of the Zodiac, to help you pilot a gigantic (metal) Volta! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282930/VoltaX/]Pick up Volta-X on sale for $9.99 (50% off)[/url] and paint your Volta red for luck in your next battle.

Generally, generosity and kindness begets prosperity. Find out if the kind-hearted skeleton Dokuro’s generosity in helping the Princess escape the Dark Lord’s castle leads to prosperity for the daring duo by helping them solve puzzles! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/317840/Dokuro/]Dokuro will be on sale for a staggering $0.99 (90% off!!!)[/url].

Like, you’re pretty darn lucky, because [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/794600/LET_IT_DIE/]two LET IT DIE bundles are available[/url]! The first bundle, which is $14.99 (50% off), contains 50 Death Metals, which you can spend to help you get you back on your feet if you want to continue taking on the Tower of Barbs after dying! The second bundle, which is $24.99 (50% off), contains 30 Death Metals and a 30-day Express Pass, which offers things like access to the Royal Elevator, a once-a-day “limited decal” login bonus, and more.

May the new year bring you happiness and prosperity. Thank you for being as GungHo about our games as we are and hope you get to enjoy some of our favorite games at their limited sale prices while you can!

notes.title: Take Advantage of a Terrifyingly Low Price on GRANDIA II HD Remaster
notes.content:
It’s that time of year again, filled with pumpkin spiced lattes, cool crisp air, and some howling good deals for the Halloween Sale on Steam. Stay inside and celebrate Halloween safely this year by picking up some candy for yourself as well as the following GungHo titles at a discounted price from 10/29-11/2 PT! 

Keep it classic and nab[i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034860/GRANDIA_HD_Remaster/] GRANDIA HD Remaster[/url][/b][/i] for $13.99 (30% off) or [i][b]GRANDIA II HD Remaster[/b][/i] also on sale for $9.99 (50% off)! If you’re not familiar with either game, see why the [i][b]GRANDIA [/b][/i]series is considered legendary and lives up to its reputation with timeless stories, real time battle systems, and much more! Follow the exciting adventures of Justin, Sue, and Feena to see what lies beyond the End of the World in [i][b]GRANDIA [/b][/i]or explore the captivating story of [i][b]GRANDIA II[/b][/i] with Ryudo and Elena in their life-changing mission.

Sad you can’t don that really cool robot costume you got earlier this year with the intention of being the biggest hit at a Halloween party? Never fear for [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282930/VoltaX/]Volta-X[/url] [/b][/i]is here at the price of $9.99 (50% off)! Get in your robot costume and then do the exact same thing, but on the digital ‘scape, with hundreds of other robot enthusiasts in [i][b]Volta-X[/b][/i]. Get into intense robot battles where you control your Volta with the assistance of the cutest crew! Upgrade and build your Volta to match your battle style, three chainsaws seems like a bit much, but you do you, boo. 

Rattle your bones with [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/317840/Dokuro/]Dokuro[/url][/b][/i], which is $2.50 (75% off) this GungHo-lloween! This isn’t your typical “save the princess” story. Follow Dokuro, a skeletal worker for the Dark Lord, as he helps the princess, whose tears broke his heart, escape from the Dark Lord’s castle after being kidnapped. Put on your thinkin' cap as you traverse through levels that seemingly get trickier and trickier as you progress. 

Like, ZOMG, [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/794600/LET_IT_DIE/]LET IT DIE[/url][/b][/i] has two special packs you can pick up at 50% off each! Download [i][b]LET IT DIE[/b][/i] for free and make your way up the Tower of Barbs with intense battles of grit and gore. Collect/concoct unique weapons and stylish ways to finish off foes… you know, to survive and all. Uncle Death’s got your back, senpai! Can you make it to the top of the Tower of Barbs if you start in your underwear, though? With the help of these one-time only DLC packs -- the Special Pack at $14.99 and the Platinum Pack at $24.99 -- you can improve your strategy to reach the top with additional Death Metals, Kill Coins, and much more, you just might be able to take on all the challenges the Tower of Barbs throws at you.

Whatever it is that you decide to do this Halloween, we hope it is fun and safe!

notes.title: GRANDIA II HD Remaster is now available on Steam!!
notes.content:
Follow Ryudo, a young mercenary Geohound, as he is tasked by the Church of Granas to protect the priestess Elena during a holy ceremony. When an attack from ancient evils forces a change in plans, Ryudo and Elena set off a perilous adventure to prevent the world from being plunged into never ending darkness. Joined by classic characters like Millenia and Roan, level up your team in battles against iconic enemies and build your spells with Mana Eggs. notes.title: Grandia offers so much more than a tremendous battle system
notes.content:
When people talk about Grandia - a series that sparked into life on the Saturn and original PlayStation - they talk about its battle system. It's often cited as the best ever in a role-playing game, and it's easy to see why - it combined situational awareness with the comforts of turn-based decision making, allowing you to take your time to line up attacks that can strike multiple foes, or escape harm yourself with the right positioning of your party, all while managing the gauge that allowed you to delay the enemy's advances while making your own.

Sampling Grandia's combat again on the HD Collection on Switch - the first chance to revisit the original since its debut - proves that yes, the combat is tremendous, and has arguably been never bettered. Even with a no-frills port that buffers sharp 2D character sprites in a 3D world to a glossy sheen, Grandia's combat continues to stand up against the many fumbled attempts since to evolve turn-based battles into something more involving.

But there is more to the series than its combat. When I think of Grandia, I think of adventure - of mysterious ruins, crossing vast oceans and trudging through stickily humid jungles. This is in part due to how the story plays out; our hero Justin, a budding explorer who inherited a mysterious stone from his missing adventurer father, is given a message from a lost civilization to return it to where it belongs - several continents away - acting as an excuse to set off, see the world and make a few friends along the way.

notes.title: Grandia I and II remasters coming to Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
Grandia and its sequel are coming to the Nintendo Switch, courtesy to GungHo Online Entertainment America.

According to a press release, HD versions of the two GameArts Japanese role-playing games are being released as a "combo pack" for Switch this winter, while the original is also coming to Steam - joining a remaster of the sequel that's already available.

Aside from their HD treatment, what the remaster treatment entails is a mystery right now. Grandia II on Steam adds "visual upgrades to textures, lighting and shadows", the option for Japanese voices, and an additional difficulty level, if that's any indication.
